pairs.registryProposal: archive-extraction-safety is written for multi-entry archives (entry names, entry counts). A single-stream compressed download (gzip of a JSON dump) only triggers the bomb and verify-before-decode clauses. Saying that explicitly in use_when would stop seats from judging gzip either fully in or fully out of scope.
